Cons

It will not let me pick specific days to recur each week. Very frustrating to expect to keep me paying more than the discounted price next year.

title: Shameful and predatory development practices
body:
Having bought the premium version of the app, I expect to be able to use the premium features perpetually. Instead the developer has shifted to an annual subscription model, and my previously bought premium version is nullified.

I understand stand the shift to a subscription model from a business perspective, however it is a predatory and unfaithful to your early supporters to revoke access to features they bought outright.

Another app called Strong (workout app) had a similar shift of business model, and honoured people who previously purchased the premium version while allowing new customers on to the subscription model. You should look to them for an example of integrity.

The app itself is decent, but I would not suggest that anyone support these developers given the number of alternative habit apps out there.

The subscription pop up is nauseating, not to mention its countdown timer pressuring payment auto renews after expiring. Big integrity drop. I’ve reached out to the developer without response so far. Previously they were prompt to respond. Really hoping will receive contact soon notifying of a bug fix and taking on board the feedback thoughtfully. Habit building requires daily consistency, app muck ups at this scale negatively impact habit flows. Considering looking for another option to replace this one if there isn’t communication working the issues through soon

Edit: the developer seems to have addressed a lot of the issues that came up earlier this year and the app is operating reasonably well again so I’ve modified my star rating.

title: The developer owes us all an explanation
body:
This app now requires a SUBSCRIPTION even if you have PREVIOUSLY PURCHASED the app. 

Yes, it seems that after a single quiet update the premium version of this app has changed from a one-off purchase to a subscription, and now my previous premium purchase is now void. I have tried the Restore Purchase function to no avail. 

I have lost access to the widget and dark mode functionality I was promised, and now Habit aggressively advertises its new premium subscription whenever I open it - advertising the features that I already paid for and have been using for weeks. 

Developer, please tell us this is a bug and not a deliberate trick. It would be very convenient for you if the Restore Purchase function was bugged for several days, wouldn’t it? I imagine a lot of confused users have already transitioned over to the subscription, having forgotten that they already paid for premium. I very nearly did. 

I urge anyone considering using this app to wait for an explanation from the developer. You cannot trust them with your money or data until then.

title: Doesn’t care about users — don’t recommend
body:
I have been a long time user and supporter of this app, so much so that I purchased a lifetime premium account a few years ago. 

Unfortunately, when they switched over to a subscription model, they did not grandfather in any former premium customers, so despite already paying for a lifetime account, I’m now being asked to pay again. 

I completely understand why they switched to a new model, but it was a poor business choice to exclude all of their previous customers and essentially screw us over. Clearly they do not have loyalty to their existing customer base and think they can just replace us with new customers… if you’re one of those new customers, be aware that in a few years, you’ll probably be the ones getting screwed over! 

I am switching over to one of the 100s of other available habit tracking apps today.

title: Greedy update
body:
This was an awesome app and I was planning on paying for the premium features, but without warning the developer changed it from a one time $5 for life purchase to a $50 PER YEAR subscription. Not all apps need to have subscriptions, and a simple one like this falls into that category in my opinion. If you want to limit the amount of free habits so after say 10 people have to buy the full price (one time fee), great, I understand. But to increase the price by 10x and make it annual with zero heads up and not grandfathering in prior paying customers is just wrong. 

I always recommend this app to people trying to improve their life, but in its current state I can not.

Tip to the developer: 
Revert the change back, and cut down development on the app to only critical updates. It’s near perfect as is so if you can keep it updated to work on new IOS versions it would be fine. Use that extra time to work on a new app that you can set up with a subscription from the start. That way your loyal customers will not be burned, and anyone checking out your new app will know what they are getting into.

title: Thank You
body:
This is the best habit tracking app, by far. And I’ve tried many.

It has the weekly overview type of interface which allows you to see the week’s progress and quickly know if you’ve been slacking off or not.

It also calculates the percentage of your habit, which represents your progress of building the habit.

It’s also completely free, and this is the thing that I really want to thank the developers for, in the day and age of subscriptions, they kept their app free without restricting the apps main features. Thank you 🥲

I urge you to pay the small price for the premium version to directly support these amazing developers and it’s a pay once, own forever type thing. And as a bonus you get cute customization options.

title: App looks good, not sold on functionality
body:
The app is nice to look at but I’m not sold on it yet, I bought the premium version to transfer my data but it didn’t seem to work. Unless it just takes some time to backup or something. I got a new phone and was unable to restore a backup, where does my data even backup to? iCloud? Doesn’t really say within the app, I can toggle it to backup via iCloud in the settings but just ended up manually re-entering all my habits. 

Which brings me to my next issue: There should be an easier way (unless I am missing something) to select previous days where you completed the habit. Selecting individual days takes forever, especially when you have to confirm your selection each time. I have only been tracking my habits for around 2 months (not that long) I would’ve deleted the app and sought a refund if I had been tracking longer, just way too time consuming.

Edit - 18/0520: Also I think I should be able to select which days I want to reminded to complete the habit... for example if I only want to complete a habit (like run 5km) 4 days per week I should be able to set which days I want to track that habit...

title: Fantastic, simple habit tracker
body:
I love this habit tracker due to its simplicity and ease of use. I ended up purchasing the app almost immediately once I saw that, if you do, you get widget functionality plus some other features. Having the widget makes the app absolutely perfect in comparison to a lot of the other ones I‘ve used, which not only have egregious payment plans, but also lack a relative increase in functionality for how much you pay. The widget lets you check off the habits without even having to open your phone, making opening the app itself almost entirely pointless (something I adore in apps like this). 
If you‘re going to go with this app, drop the cash for the full version, and go slow with adding new habits so you don‘t burn yourself out of using it. Overall, I don‘t see myself using any other habit tracker. Essentially perfect habit tracker app, in my opinion, as it has user experience in mind while simultaneously being humble in its price if you so choose to purchase it, a rarity nowadays.

title: Great app but has opportunity for improvement
body:
This app is SIMPLE! You don’t need to sign up (at all) which I love. I’m tired of having to put my email somewhere to try the app out. This one doesn’t require that which is awesome. 

I didn’t give it 5 stars because I’m wanting a bit more customization. Here’s my hopes for this app:
- be able to choose the colours of the tasks
- be able to choose what days you see (3 past, current and 3 upcoming would be ideal)
- be able to select ‘every other day’ as a recurrence 
- be able to choose what the percentage means (the developer has commented a few times that this is based on an algorithm and once it’s complete 110 times, it will be 100%, but that seems pointless; what does 110 times completed mean to me? Nothing.) 
- see how many times you’ve chosen to complete something (ex. If I choose 3 times per week, I would like to see 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 as I complete if). 

Again, these are wishes for this apps improvement. It’s exceptionally simple, minimalistic, and easy to use. I’m hoping it helps me stick to my goals. 

Great app! I look forward to future improvements.

title: A pity this business model killed it
body:
Great design and functions. A pity this new business model now killed it for me. The premium model is not well presented, meaning you could easily activate it without realising. Then you pay 49€ for a relatively simple app. Happy to pay a one time fee but a subscription model for an app like that…not sure for me.

Anyways, good luck to the team behind, it’s great tech, function and especially design!

title: Artificial paywall
body: Attractive layout but deliberately made borderline unusable if you use it for free, permitting only three(!) tasks unless you pay a monthly fee. Advertising this app as “free” is absolutely misleading.

title: Beste Habit App
body:
Meine absolute Lieblings-App um Gewohnheiten aufzubauen und meines Wissens die einzige, die den Aufbau von Gewohnheiten in einer logarithmischen Logik unterstützt statt (wie alle anderen Apps) so zu tun als sei es etwas lineares. 

Diese App ist viel näher an der psychologischen Realität. Am Anfang ist es leicht, später wird es schwer, und nur weil man mal einen Tag verpasst hat, ist der Erfolg nicht gleich zunichte. Deshalb variiert der prozentuale Fortschritt. Geniales Konzept und sehr motivierend, wenn man es einmal verstanden hat.

title: Nur bedingt nutzbar
body: So weit ganz nett. Ich habe jetzt eine Weile vier Gewohnheiten getrackt, das ist das Maximum, was mit der Gratisversion möglich ist. Worauf sich die Prozente beziehen bzw wie diese errechnet werden, ist für mich nicht ganz durchsichtig. Was mich sehr ärgert, ist, dass die maximal vier Gewohnheiten scheinbar nicht nur eine Begrenzung dessen, was man gleichzeitig tracken kann, sondern eine Gesamtgrenze darstellen. Ich habe jetzt eine meiner vier Gewohnheiten gelöscht, weil ich stattdessen eine andere tracken wollte, das ist aber nicht möglich. Obwohl ich nur noch drei habe, werde ich dauernd zum Abo geschickt, wenn ich eine weitere hinzufügen möchte. Darüber sollte man von Anfang an zumindest klar informiert werden, denn dan hätte ich meine vierte Gewohnheit gar nicht erst gelöscht. Und ganz ehrlich: bei Abomodellen bin ich extrem selektiv, einen Einmalkauf würde ich mir überlegen, aber ein recht teures Abo für doch recht simple Funktionen kommen für mich einfach nicht in Frage.

I had purchased the premium functions prior the update to the new subscription model.
With the Update my already payed for premium features got revoked and I‘m now being asked to pay a yearly subscription. I tried contacting the support via Instagram no answer. And via email which ends with an autoresponder informing you to contact a non existent/not working support e-mail address.

I really liked the app and was using it on a daily basis until the new version and payment method was implemented. Would have give it 5 stars but because of the lack of customer support and revoking my premium features that had already been payed for only 2 stars now. I hope somday someone will reply to me and fix this and I would gladly resume using and recommending the app!
author: frozillamania

title: MEGA
body:
Diese App ist einfach der Hammer ich ernähre mich seit 14 Tage gesünder und ich halte mich Fit 
Ich kann diese App nur weiter empfehlen 👍🏻
author: b der her zur

title: Kundensupport antwortet nicht
body: Schade, eigentlich finde ich die App super und minimalistisch, habe dann extra Geld für die Pro Version ausgegeben weil ich ein Widget haben wollte. Dieses Widget existiert aber nicht und auch nach mehrmaliger Kontaktaufnahme mit dem Support keine Antwort und keine Reaktion. Eine absolute Frechheit!!!
author: kapputschino

title: Seit dem Update nur noch nervig
body:
Die app erinnert einen mittlerweile bei jeden start an ein (vermeintlich heute auslaufendes) premium Angebot als abo

Muss mich jetzt leider auf die suche nach einer neuen app machen
author: Wthsrd

title: Eigentlich ganz nett...
body:
... aber jetzt in Jahresabo obwohl ich schon eine lebenslange Version für eine Einmalzahlung erworben habe. 
Das ist erstens ziemlich frech und zweitens für den Leistungsumfang zum Jahrespreis auch echt viel.
author: meyer_zwo

title: Dreistes Update- niemals ein Abo für einen Tracker!
body:
App developer changed their mind and now I could restore my purchase.. no annoying premium subscription anymore. 

Developer announced to do a widget feature, but sadly there is no widget :(
author: Dex-iOs

title: Enttäuschender Scam
body: Wie sehr vielen anderen Nutzern wurde mir durch das letzte Update ohne Vorwarnung meine UNLIMITED Premium-Funktion, für die ich erst Anfang des Jahres 5,49 € bezahlt habe, genommen, und nun wird aggressiv beworben, dass ich 44€ im Jahr bezahlen sollte. Das ist so ein Hintergehen von allen NutzerInnen wie mir, die gerne die Premiumversion gekauft haben um so eine simple(!!) aber schön designte App zu unterstützen. Ich werde versuchen das Geld zurück zu bekommen und die App dann löschen. Absolut nicht vertrauenswürdige Entwickler, Finger weg!
author: T_f9360

title: Why do I have to pay again?
body: I am really upset about the app. A year ago I bought the full premium version for 5,49€ and it was written that I have total and unlimited access to the app. Now suddenly I have to pay more then twice as much for one year! I really loved the app but now I don’t want to use it anymore. Not under this circumstances
author: sehr zuverlässige App!

title: Danke für das Update.
body:
Durch das neue Update konnte ich den Kauf wiederherstellend. Vielen Dank dafür.
Seit dem kann ich die App wie gewohnt nutzen und bin sehr froh darüber. 

Was mir an den Habit Tracker am meisten gefällt ist der Funktionsumfang. Viele Apps die helfen Gewohnheiten im Auge zu behalten sind für meinen Geschmack viel zu überladen.
Der Habit Tracker konzentriert sich auf das wesentliche und lässt sich so sehr gut in den eigenen Alltag intrigieren.
author: Criosul

title: Nervig
body: Absolut unnötiges Aufdrängen der Premium-Version, sobald man die App öffnet, sodass die App jetzt wieder gelöscht wird.
author: lindalynn2021

title: Probably the best habit tracker I‘ve used but shady sales tactics
body: Absolutely excellent habit tracker which I’ve used for over a year now. However the advertising to convert me to a paid user has become way too obnoxious recently. Most importantly trying to fool users with the countdown timer that never actually expires and the lack of a lifetime-option to purchase keeps me from actually buying the app. If I‘m already being lied to to make the purchase I might as well stay away. A shame because the app itself is actually pretty good.
author: CE0311

title: Restore lifetime premium
body: Guys, you can restore your purchase: Click on preium, scroll to the very bottom. Click restore. It won't work at the first time. Try a couple times (in between kill the app). On the second or third try it will restore
author: 12gjsjdgj23

title: Subscription
body: I understand that the developer wants to switch to a subscription model but I literally purchased the lifetime premium app a few days before it was removed. No reply to emails either. Next time plan this better please.
author: Lutz9999

title: Scam. Bezahlte Features immer noch weg
body: Ich habe aufgrund meines Vorgängers nochmal geschaut, kann aber weiterhin kein Premium wiederherstellen. Und das obwohl ich erst im Oktober die App gekauft habe. Finger weg von der App!
author: Bahnuuu

title: Liebe die App!!
body: super hilfreich
author: Laryy61

title: Funktionen sind toll
body:
Ich mag, dass ich eine Übersicht über alle Habits habe und dort sehen kann, wie die letzten Monate gelaufen sind. Deshalb würde ich die normale Version immer wieder downloaden! 
Aber: ich habe im Dezember Premium gekauft, als es noch kein jährliches Bezahlsystem gab. Das Widget hat nicht funktioniert, auf meine Anfrage hat niemand reagiert. Nun habe ich gestern die App geupdated und wenn ich Premium weiter nutzen möchte, muss ich nun jährlich einen Obolus entrichten, habe ich gemacht, das Widget ist immernoch nicht da - auch nach mehrmaligem Neustart. Da überlegt man sich doch nochmal, ob man nicht eine andere App nutzen möchte.
author: sarahlinafina

title: Mega
body:
Die geilste Habit App ever. 
Wahrlich. 
Und Ich habe bestimmt 10 getestet. 
Toller Leistungsumfang. 
Schade ist nur die Geldeintreibungs Art & Weise. Zuerst war es gratis. Dann gegen Spende. Und seit dem letzten Update gehen alle Funktionen nur noch im ABO. 
Aber die Spende nahmt ihr dennoch gerne?
Schade. Deshalb nur 4 Sterne.
author: DerGesundheitsexperte

title: Unlauteres Geschäftsgebaren
body: Wie andere schon geschrieben haben: Gekaufte (!!!) Funktionen wurden einfach entfernt, die Wiederherstellung ist nicht möglich und man soll ein Abo abschließen, um die Funktionen wieder zu bekommen. Unfassbar, dass so eine App im App-Store überhaupt zugelassen ist!
author: tobinaut

title: Abonnement statt Kaufen
body: Eigentlich mochte ich die App sehr. Ich hatte mir sogar die Vollversion gekauft, weil ich so begeistert war und die Zusatzfunktionen nutzen wollte. Nun ist mein Kauf allerdings ‚weg‘ und ich müsste auf ein Abo umsteigen, um wieder alles im gewohnten Umfang nutzen zu können. Ich persönlich mag Abomodelle gar nicht. Frech finde ich, dass mir meine vorher gekauften Inhalte quasi weggenommen werden.
author: LChristin

title: Abzocke
body: Kann mich meinen Vorrednern nur anschließen. Ich hatte mir damals die Premium-Funktionen per In-App-Kauf gekauft - und zwar gerne, weil ich die App super fand! Von den Premium-Funktionen ist jetzt nichts mehr zu sehen und es wird so aggressiv für das Premium-Modell geworben, das die App für mich kaum mehr nutzbar ist. Ich werde auf eine andere App umsteigen!
author: Philipp Ha

title: Richtig frech!
body: Habe die App vor ein paar Monaten gekauft und war auch immer ganz zufrieden. Habe vor allem das Widget immer genutzt. Jetzt gibt es plötzlich premium als Abo und ich soll für diese einfach gestrickte App monatlich löhnen. Mein Widget funktioniert nicht mehr. Das nenne ich mal richtig frech!
author: Laker2211

title: The popups don’t stop
body: It’s really annoying to click through „please purchase premium“ popups at every usage
author: Anonymous User 5271

title: Scam Scam Scam
body: Wofür bezahlt man für Premium, wenn einem kurze Zeit später, trotz Bezahlung, ein Abo angeboten wird (10 Mal so teuer) und man seine eigentlichen Premium Updates nicht mehr nutzen kann? Scam.
author: shirin.bnz

title: Update entfernt bezahlte Premiumfunktionen
body:
Eigentlich eine nützliche App, für die ich vor einigen Monaten gerne eine einmalige Zahlung über den App Store getätigt habe.
Schade das der Entwickler plötzlich (und ohne irgendeinen Hinweis in den Release Notes) auf ein teures Abomodell umstellt und den Kunden die vorher bezahlt haben die Premiumfunktionen einfach wieder wegnimmt. Das Verhalten ist bedenklich, rechtlich zweifelhaft (ein Kauf im App Store stellt schließlich einen Kaufvertrag dar) und mal ehrlich, wer ist bereit für diese Anwendung jährlich 43,99 Euro zu bezahlen?
Auf E-Mails wird nicht reagiert.
author: ts010101

title: Es war mal schön..
body: Ich nutze die App nun eine Weile und war sehr zufrieden mit Funktion und Design. Alles kostenlos und für freiwillige 5€  noch kleine Features oben drauf. So schön war es mal. Ärgerlich, dass ohne Vorankündigung gekaufte Funktionen entfernt und auf ein nerviges Abomodell umgeschwängt wurde.
author: Lucatihl

title: BETRUG
body:
So schön die App eigentlich ist, der Entwickler hat hier ein falsches Versprechen in Bezug auf die Lieferung eines Widgets genutzt, um Nutzer zur Bezahlung der Pro-Version zu bewegen. Nun gibt es eine neue Version mit Abo-Modell für Premiumfunktionen, ohne dass das versprochene Widget je existiert hat. Der zuvor erworbene Pro-Status ist mit dem Update verloren und wird scheinbar auch nicht wiederhergestellt. Das schlussfolgere ich daraus, dass der Entwickler auf keinerlei Zuschriften reagiert. 

Traurig.
author: RobertL2209

title: Update hat Premium gelöscht
body:
Seit dem neusten Update besitze ich kein premium mehr, welches ich vor zwei Wochen gekauft habe. 
“Zahle einmal und nutze es ein Leben lang”
wurde nun zu “zahle 43,99€ im Jahr”

... bin damit absolut nicht glücklich!

Ich habe den Support angeschrieben - kam keine Antwort. Habe dann eine Rückerstattung bei Apple beantragt und die Summe erstattet bekommen. 

Traurige abzocke...
author: Mango1992

title: Abzocker
body: Habe mir letztes Jahr die Premium Features gekauft. Seit dem letzten Update sind die Features deaktiviert und ich kann meinen Kauf nicht wiederherstellen. Auf E-Mails wird nicht geantwortet.
author: Diddl88

title: Schrott
body: Die App ist nach dem neusten Update nicht mehr zu gebrauchen. Man erhält dauernd eine Meldung auf Premium umzusteigen für 13,49 € jährlich (was absolut nicht gerechtfertigt ist). Die ganzen Funktionen die vorher umsonst waren funktionieren nun nicht. Alles in allen ist die App schlecht geworden und ich teste jetzt Alternativen.
author: Fl_ri

title: Kein Widget trotz Premium
body: Ich nutze diese App schon ziemlich lange und war eigentlich immer sehr zufrieden. Habe mir vor ungefähr einer Woche die Premium Version für ein Jahr gekauft, um unter anderem die Widget Funktion freizuschalten. Diese funktioniert jedoch trotzdem nicht, ich werde aufgefordert dafür noch einmal die Premium Version nun bis zum Jahr 2023 zu kaufen!? Eine bodenlose Frechheit. Auch auf meine Email wurde nicht geantwortet. Finger weg von dieser App!
author: Johnny_kzn

title: Abzocke / Scam
body:
Ich habe vor ein paar Wochen die lebenslange Premiumfunktion gekauft und ohne Ankündigung ist der Entwickler auf eine jährliche Gebühr gewechselt. Dadurch sind die gekauften Funktionen nicht mehr nutzbar. Weder der Entwickler noch Apple zeigen sich Einsichtig. Abzocke!

Bought the premium package a few weeks ago but now the developer is charging a yearly fee for the premium functions. Thus, I am not able to use what I paid for. Both the developer and Apple reject a refund or reactivation of premium features for user who bought them. Scam!
author: Stephan15a

title: Abofalle, Funktionseinschränkung
body: Nervt unendlich, Premium abzuschliessen, geht dann auf 45€ automatische Verlängerung und hat das Widget zerschossen. Well done!
author: Kinokind23

title: Nach dem Update Premium weg
body: Hatte freiwillig für Premium bezahlt und nun Premium nach dem Update weg. Finde ich nicht okay. Werde Alternative suchen!
author: vladmeqo

title: „ den Kauf Wiederherstellen“ nicht möglich
body:
Obwohl ich vor dem letzten Update premium hatte ist nach dem Update ein kostenpflichtiges Abo nötig. Den Kauf kann man leider nicht wiederherstellen. 

Eine Frechheit!
author: elcikokartal

title: Your latest update
body:
Hi Habit Team, generally I love your app and during the last year it helped me to develop four habits, so your app is exactly what it is meant to be: a habit-developer-helper ;-)) and you would definitely get 5 stars from me.
Now here comes the BUT: Since your last update three days ago I‘m somehow upset and also a bit angry because I already decided to go premium last summer and I have paid for premium and now I’m back to regular and the app offers me a new purchase to go back to premium. I would have totally understand when you have said „hey, we have worked hard on it and we have decided to change our payment method and we offer you a special deal as an already premium user...“ but no info in advance at all and a switch „over night“ - no so funny. Hope you can understand my frustration.
author: sarah_jayne1979-1

title: Abzocke
body:
Die App ist solide, nicht überladen und tut, was sie soll. Das hat mich eigentlich begeistert und auch dazu gebracht für die Pro-Version zu bezahlen. Zwei Wochen später steigen die Entwickler auf ein Abo-Modell um und alle Funktionen, für die man bezahlt hat, sind wieder gesperrt! Stattdessen soll ich nun jährlich dafür zahlen...!?
Ich verstehe das gute Arbeit bezahlt werde muss, absolut! Aber die zuvor bezahlten Funktionen zu Gunsten eines Abos zu entfernen, ist richtig mieses Verhalten!!! Die App ist gut, aber wegen eines solchen Umgangs kann ich nur jedem von der App abraten 😡
author: Krysch63227

title: Schade
body: An sich ist das App ganz nett. Ich habe auch vor 2 Wochen für 5,49€ den Kauf, also den einmaligen Kauf bestätigt und die Features freigeschaltet (Themes & Backup) Unbegrenzte habits war in der Freiversion schon drin gewesen. So weit so gut, bis zum Update!  Auf einmal ist die Nutzung in Abo umgewandelt und mein Kauf vor 2 Wochen war auch futsch!  Unglaublich.
author: Jimbako

title: Please upgrade or refund your already paying users
body: I paid for the previous version of your app, now with the new version (which btw installed automatically) I have to pay subscription to have access to the same features I’ve paid for previously.
author: santosivosantos

title: Frechheit
body:
Als ich mich für diese App entschieden habe, habe ich für zusätzliche Funktionen einen freiwilligen Betrag gezahlt um das Produkt nutzen zu können und es wurde suggeriert, dass mit dieser Zahlung die App dauerhaft mit den zusätzlichen Funktionieren nutzbar ist. 
Heute musste ich feststellen, dass jetzt ein Abo fällig wird! 
Und wenn ich das Abo nicht mache sind die von mir bereits gezahlten Funktionen futsch. 
Das Abo ist ohne vorherige Ankündigung gekommen. 
Da guck ich doch mal, welche App zum tracken meiner Gewohnten vielleicht noch besser ist
author: Olivervonschoeneberg

title: WARNUNG
body:
Betreiber der App cancelt die 4,99€ Lifetime Premium Funktionen und fordert dann monatlich einen hohen Geldbetrag. Onlinebetrug?

Fall für die Aufsichtsbehörde.
author: Riunatic

title: Absolute Frechheit!!! Höchst unseriöses Geschäftsmodell
body: Vor ein paar Monaten Premiumversion gekauft, jetzt alle Premiumvorteile verloren, weil die App auf Abomodell umgestellt wurde. Das sind höchst unseriöse Geschäftspraktiken. App wird gelöscht und definitiv davon abgeraten diese zu benutzen. Wer weiß was sich die Betreiber noch einfallen lassen, um den Leuten das Geld aus der Tasche zu ziehen.
author: BernieVain

title: Mit dem Update kam die Werbung
body: Seit dem Update wird man alle paar Klicks damit genervt, ein kostenpflichtiges Abo abzuschließen. Schade drum. Gibt aber genug Alternativen.
author: Croeschert

title: Kauf geht mit Update verloren, jetzt jährliches Abo? Hackt‘s euch?
body: Habe vor ca. 4 Wochen die Premium Version für ca 5 Euro gekauft. Mit dem neuen Update ist die Premium-Version weg und ich soll über 40 Euro für ein Jahresabo zahlen. Kauf lässt sich auch nicht wiederherstellen. Ihr habt doch den Schuss nicht gehört Leute!
author: Tubenfalz

title: Nett, aber was soll das mit dem Premium?
body: Ich habe mir die App vor kurzem geholt und auch bezahlt für Premium Modell. Keine krassen features, aber ich wollte die Macher unterstützen. Jetzt auf einmal gibt es ein Premium Modell als Abo. Meinen Einkauf kann ich nicht „restoren“ und ich bleibe bei der kostenlosen Ansicht wie vor meinem Kauf. Ich habe mich für die App entschieden, weil ich das Konzept gut finde und auch gerne dafür zahle. Soll ich jetzt noch mal zahlen und das dann immer wieder? Nein danke. Tut mir Leid, aber ich habe keine Interesse zwei mal innerhalb kurzer Zeit Geld dafür zu zahlen und auch jetzt immer wieder mit der Werbung für Premium genervt zu werden.
author: Purrrrrry

title: Paid for the App, now I have to pay again? No way.
body:
I bought this app in December 2020, paid the full price for the full version. Now, in January 2021, the developers have decided to make it a subscription service, and so I have lost access to most of my habits, and lost access to the widget.
This is disgustingly greedy behaviour. At the very least, it should be available in full to those who supported the app in its early days, without forcing them to pay AGAIN for access. I will be deleting the app. These scammers should be ashamed of themselves.
author: Aiolometis

title: This App got bought out
body: This App got bought out by the "Reflectly" developer and introduced monthly payments for an App that was already completely paid for. This is very much a scam.
author: Lahusen

title: Fraud. Stay away
body: A few weeks ago I paid five euro one time payment for some premium features. All features are gone now. Now they changed to a subscription model for €40 a year, with exactly the same features I already paid for.  The support does not answer. My report to the Apple App Store is submitted.
author: tibi512

title: Newest update removing premium functions
body:
As many others have stated, I bought the one-time premium version. Since the newest update however, I’m not able to use the premium functions anymore (despite paying for them) and am asked to pay the subscription fee. Restoring my purchase doesn’t work.
Not sure when (or if) this will be fixed.
author: s_r_13

title: Fraud?
body: Just unlocked a few weeks ago the premium version. Now with the new update, all premium feature I paid for is gone and the developer change the pricing to subscription. I hope the developer will fixed it, so all the previous buyer will get what they paid for. Otherwise it is just bad practice, well not only that. It would just be fraud
author: swz-ka

title: Was soll das?
body: Ich habe Anfang Januar für Premium bezahlt und jetzt wurde meine App wieder auf die kostenlose Version zurückgesetzt?! Kauf wiederherstellen funktioniert auch nicht. Die App war teuer genug! Sicher zahle ich nicht zweimal! Ich hoffe, mein Premium wird bald wiederhergestellt. Enttäuschend.
author: Frau Ko

title: Grundsätzlich ok.
body:
Ein Punkt Abzug, weil man Erinnerungen nicht mehrmals täglich einstellen kann.
Ein Punkt Abzug für das Abomodel und hierbei einen weiteren für die Preisvorstellungen.
Und einen weiteren, weil ich vor nicht mal zehn Tagen schon mal bezahlt habe „Premium Einmalzahlung“!
Das Geld hätte ich mir sparen können!!
author: FS.S.13

title: Umstellung auf Abo
body: Unverschämt bei einer bereits gekauften App sich die gleichen Funktionen ab jetzt als Jahresabo bezahlen zu lassen!!!
author: LycidasFx

title: Frechheit
body:
Ich habe die App vor 2 Monaten kostenlos erworben. Mit einer Spende an die Entwickler gab es das PRO Update, welches sich nicht gelohnt hat!
Nun wollen die tatsächlich ein Abo?
Wie dreist ist das denn???
Und dann auch noch für eine stinklangweilige App?! Unglaublich!!!
author: Christinalein

title: Useless
body: The App is useless since the new update came out.  It is only possible to track up to 3 habits without subscription, which’s less than in other habit tracking apps. Up until now really enjoyed the app, but now with only being able to track 3 habits and the sale banner for subscription each time you open the app, there is no point of keeping it.
author: lif468

title: Premium-Kauf durch Update verloren
body:
Leider ist mit dem letzten Update (Jan 2021) mein Premium-Account deaktiviert worden und einzelne Funktionen sind entsprechend nicht mehr verfügbar. 

Dies war weder zum Zeitpunkt des Kaufes (kein Abo, Einmalzahlung) ersichtlich, noch durch Kommunikation seitens der Entwickler vorab angekündigt.
author: janine111111

title: Premium gekauft, aber Widget ging verloren
body: Ich habe letztes Jahr im Sommer das Premium Produkt für 5,49€ gekauft, um das Widget Feature nutzen zu können. Jetzt wollte ich die App wieder nutzen, aber das Widget ist jetzt unbrauchbar, da ich ein Abo abschließen muss und das trotz vorherigen Kaufs...
author: NiftyMP

title: Premium wird ersetzt mit subscription model
body: Ich habe premium gekauft davor, das ist jetzt weg und ich soll es als Abo model kaufen?
author: maddin25

title: Ab heute nur noch mit Jahres-Subscription
body: Eigentlich eine ganz nette App die optisch schön minimalistisch ist. die Möglichkeit bis vor ein Paar Tagen einen freien Betrag für premium zu bezahlen fand ich mehr als angemessen und sollte auch nach ein Paar Tagen des Testens umgesetzt werden. Seit heute gibt es aber leider die Möglichkeit nicht mehr, nur noch Jahresabo ist verfügbar. Oder man bleibt kostenlos ist aber maximal eingeschränkt. Jeder muss Geld verdienen, aber bitte nicht für alles ein Jahresabo! Einmalzahlung 4 Sterne, kostenlose Version ohne Abo durch die Einschränkungen leider nur 1 Stern.
author: Photography12456

title: One time to annually
body:
Eigentlich eine super App.
Das ursprüngliche Bezahlmodell hat sich abgehoben, weil man selber entscheiden konnte, welchen Einmal Betrag man zahlt.
Nun wurde das Bezahlmodell geändert auf eine regelmäßige Zahlung und mein Premium Zugang ist trotz der einmaligen Zahlung weg? Das soll wohl ein Scherz sein.
author: DaHubeydubey

title: Leider auch zum Abo Modell verkommen
body:
War es bisher möglich verschiedene Funktionen wie beispielsweise Widget durch Zahlung eines einmaligen Betrages zu bekommen, hat man nun auf ein Abo Modell umgestellt. 
Leider sind dabei die zuvor schon bezahlten Funktionen wieder weggenommen worden. 
Abzocke ! Wird direkt gelöscht. Danke !
author: bauerchris

title: Update is Bad
body: The release notes do not mention that a subscription system is introduced with this update. This is not honest. And the new payment scheme (subscriptions) is much worse than the previous one (onetime payment).
author: Qfgjkihbli

title: Kriminelle Abzocke!
body: Ich habe vor einigen Monaten mit einer Einmalzahlung einen lebenslangen Premiumzugang erworben. Seit dem neusten Update habe ich jedoch wieder die Basisversion, kann den Kauf nicht wiederherstellen und soll nun ein (viel teureres) Abo erwerben für ein Produkt, das ich bereits gekauft habe. Bodenlose Frechheit!
author: appus3r313

title: App zurückgesetzt
body: Nach dem Update werde ich nicht mehr als Premiumkunde angezeigt. Ich habe vor zwei Wochen bezahlt und jetzt? Mein ganzes Profil wurde zurückgesetzt und alle Funktionen sind wieder gesperrt. Ich will mein Geld zurück.
author: Qwatza

title: tolles update 😡
body:
Snooze-Funktion jetzt nur noch im ABO??? Und überhaupt: für eine derartige Reminderapp ein ABO???
Muss ich leider löschen.
author: mosch123

title: Kein Premium mehr durch Update
body: Durch das heutige Update wurde mein Premium offenbar zurückgesetzt. Ich habe die erweiterten Funktionen bereits vor einiger Zeit gekauft, nun sind sie nicht mehr vorhanden. „Kontaktiere uns“ in der App funktioniert ebensowenig.
author: jul0987654321

title: It used to be a great app...
body:
With the newest update the developers started a subscription model without a warning and without thinking about their existing customers. When I installed it 1 year ago, I payed the optional 4,99€ (or similar price, i don’t know exactly what it was) to unlock all features with pleasure to support the development. But now they degraded to the subscription model and took the features from paying customers away.  It‘s a pity and bad practice. Now on every startup I‘m plagued with a sale banner. 

Stay away!
author: pvlvsk

title: Kein Widget
body:
Habe mich über eine simple App ohne Schnickschnack gefreut, bekommen habe ich eine Aop, die eigentlich nichts weiter ist, als eine simple Liste mit Erinnerung und prozentualer Auswertung, passt so. Allerdings finde ich den Preis von mehr als 5 EUR für die Freischaltung eines Widgets nicht gerechtfertigt, der Entwickler setzt aber noch einen drauf und macht eine Preisstaffelung. Die ist zwar freiwillig, aber die ganze App kommt mir dadurch so vor, als ginge es um nichts weiter als Monetarisierung.
Nun ja, auch damit kann ich noch ungehen. Aber jetzt kommts, es gibt kein Widget. Ist einfach keins in der Liste. 

Wir haben hier also eine App, für die der Entwickler (je nach Können) eine oder wenige Stunden investiert hat, das ganze mit einem übertriebenen Preis für „Premium“, was dann vom Darkmode abgesehen nicht mal funktioniert. Btw, der Darkmode ist nichts, was wirklich Arbeit in XCode macht. Wenn das deine Monetarisierungs-Konzept ist, überleg dir was schlaueres...

Leute, lasst euch nicht verarschen, nutzt entweder die kostenlose Version oder greift woanders zu.
author: skate_berlin

title: Schlecht übersetzt- poor translation
body:
Selbst mit viel Phantasie sind die Erklärungen  auf deutsch in der Prime Version nicht gut nachzuvollziehen.

Unfortunately the german translation doesn‘t make sense in quite a few parts. Makes the App less fun to use and motivation sinks.

title: Fehlerhafter Algorithmus
body:
Eigentlich eine wirklich tolle Idee und ein wirklich schönes Design mit einer motivierenden Visualisierung der Gewohnheiten. Nur leider ist der Algorithmus, der die Prozentangabe einer Gewohnheit berechnet nicht nachvollziehbar und meiner Ansicht nach fehlerhaft.

Ich habe testweise eine Gewohnheit einige Monate rückwirkend als erledigt markiert. Gehe ich dabei weit genug zurück, dann bleibt die Gewohnheit selbst dann auf 100 % stehen, wenn ich die letzten 20 Tage des aktuellen Monats als nicht erledigt markiere. Ich muss also nur in der Vergangenheit genug Häkchen gesammelt haben, um mir ein paar Wochen Auszeit leisten zu können. Außerdem erreicht der Zähler für wöchentliche Gewohnheiten erst dann 100 %, wenn ich sie für weit über ein Jahr als erledigt markiere. Das wird schnell frustrierend.

Für mich ist die App so leider höchstens in den ersten Tagen zu gebrauchen, weil sie danach völlig unrealistische Werte anzeigt. Sehr schade.

title: Schönes Design, aber undurchsichtiges Tracking
body:
Die App hat sehr schönes, ansprechendes Design. Ohne viel Schnickschnack überzeugt die minimalistisch gestaltete Oberfläche, so dass man eine schnellen Überblick über die letzten getrackten Gewohnheiten bekommt. Ich habe viele Apps ausprobiert und die meisten nerven mit Reizüberflutung - Habit ist da ganz anders und angenehm und selbsterklärend zu benutzen. 

Bis auf eine Ausnahme: 
Es sollte die Möglichkeiten geben, Gewohnheiten nicht nur als Häkchen für „erledigt“ zu geben, sondern auch ein Symbol (ein Kreuz vielleicht?) für „nicht erledigt“. Den Kreis finde ich als Icon super. Aber es passiert sehr oft, dass  ich nicht weiß, ob ich nun die Aufgabe/Gewohnheit nicht erledigt habe, oder einfach (trotz Erinnerung) vergessen habe in der App zu tracken. So macht die App für mich weniger Sinn. 

Wenn man das ändern könnte,  wäre die App perfekt.

title: Ya reconoce compra previa
body:
La app ofrece una funcionalidad parecida a otras apps similares, pero con un estilo propio, y una característica que la distingue: un ‘porcentaje’ o ‘nivel de cumplimiento’ de cada hábito, basado en la frecuencia de las repeticiones recientes y antiguas. La fórmula exacta del cálculo de este porcentaje es mantenida en secreto por los creadores de la app, pero realmente sí sirve para tener una idea orientativa de la ‘fortaleza’ de actual de cada hábito.

Llevo usando esta app prácticamente desde que la lanzaron, y me sirve para realizar un seguimiento de ciertos hábitos y actitudes que me gusta tener presentes diariamente. Me ayuda a ser más consciente. Como he dicho arriba, su estilo particular engancha y la hace más atractiva.

title: Compte premium supprimé du jour au lendemain
body: Beaucoup de personnes avaient achetées un compte premium à vie et du jour au lendemain, le développeur de l’application a décidé de les supprimer pour passer à un système de souscription annuelle ou mensuelle. D’une part, cette souscription n’apporte aucun changement considérable (littéralement aucune mise à jour, rien de nouveau) qui pourrait justifier le basculement vers un tel modèle. D’autre part, c’est irrespectueux pour les personnes qui ont acheté un compte et qui le perdent du jour au lendemain sans aucune information. Depuis, un popup tente de nous basculer vers une souscription avec un faux compte à rebours qui « annonce » une réduction renouvelée à chaque fin de compteur. Totalement déplacé de la part du développeur, je ne recommande pas cette application.

body:

This makes the app completely unusable for long-term tracking. What’s the point of a habit tracker if it can’t even remember past progress? I expected better reliability from a paid app. Very disappointed.

body:
I love the concept of the percentage, and it has really helped me focuses on keeping up with my habits. But just adding the small feature to show how many days you’ve been on a streak for would be a massive incentive. Also needs ability to add the a start date for the habit. Most people start a habit then decide to track it after, so being able to add an earlier start date would be useful.
And widget doesn’t work!!!

Fuming

Do app developers really think we’ll spend £40 a year on every app we want?  Simple (& free) reminders in my phone will do the job too. 

When did ‘renting’ apps become the only way? Bring back pay once for an app
author: SkiChick15

I just want to track my habits in peace, without having to turn down the subscription offer. Sort it out, this app used to be so good and now it’s just trashy.
author: eggarooney

title: Would be 5* just a few weeks ago
body:
Please do not subscribe. I’m a React Native mobile developer and can tell you that this app could be developed by 1 person in a month. 

I downloaded this app and after testing it out and finding it useful, I decided to make a one-off purchase, it was absolutely worth it, I wouldn’t even mind paying a bit more. However, after only a few weeks of using it, it told me to pay again as the app changed its subscription model (in spite of no added functionalities). I contacted support and received an email saying that they would let me use the app for the price I paid for a year (as if it was a big favour). I paid with the intention to use it for the price I paid for an unlimited time. After the year passes, I will switch to a different app (or create my own scam-less app for myself and for you all).

author: 思Ceci

title: Used to be one of my favourite apps
body:
This used to be one of my favourite apps, it’s so simple and beautifully designed. You create habits, you tick them off and you gain progress. Everything about it was great.

Recently the app has just become a pain to use, every time I open it I’m spammed with a pop up asking me to upgrade to their subscription plan on some limited time discount that never seems to end. This wouldn’t be so bad but they are asking for a ridiculous amount of money on a yearly basis (£38.99 for their standard pricing).

They now lock you out of adding more habits unless you pay for their subscription making the app essentially useless if you want to build new habits. Such a shame seeing the app change for the worse so quickly.

The annoying ‘gift to yourself’ banner with a count down timer apparently is a permanent fixture and somewhat reminiscent of ground hog day as it just keeps resetting! I have deleted it now and found another habit tracker which is much better!

body:

Very disappointed and will be moving to a new habit app.

title: Great app but pushy premium message
body:
I’ve used this app for ages but recently it’s been updated with a pushy pop up message about the premium version. 

Every time you open the app the annoying pop up appears. Spoiler alert: if I haven’t wanted premium yet, I don’t now, barely an hour later. 

When the premium offer ending counter finishes it just resets back to 60 hours, so the pop ups never cease.
author: bpk68

title: One star due to annoying “offer” notifications
body:
I purchased this app as I though it was nice and simple, after paying for it, I’m now asked to subscribe every time I open it. 

An app like this should not need a subscription and I should not be asked less than a year after paying £6.99 for it (no subscription asked at the time)  

Un-installed and not recommended.
author: Scott.William

title: DO NOT GET THIS APP
body: So I’ve been using it for time and when a new subscription based plan came up I decided why not just cause I wanted a widget so I dive less deep into using my phone, and limit my use to the productivity apps and widgets I have on one page.  But turns out hundreds of people are being scammed by the apps developers!!!! They don’t answer to queries let alone relevant bug fixes and these “updates” that consist of removing and re adding a premium subscription arent new. DONT GET THIS APP!!!!! IF ANYTHING REPORT IT SO THOSE OF US WHO PAID MONEY FOR NOTHING CAN GET A REFUND!!!!!
author: IndeBiggy

title: So much for ‘“one off lifetime purchase”
body: After getting premium for a one off lifetime purchase the new update is now asking for a yearly subscription commitment and I’m won’t restore my premium purchase. What a con.
author: Princess Conseula

title: Pay twice?...
body:
I initially really enjoyed this app when I downloaded it last year, so much so that I upgraded to ‘pro’ for £5.99. Today the app updated and to unlock those same features, I need to pay £38.99. 

Maybe consider a key reason the app is successful is because people like me have bought into it early doors. I wouldn’t mind paying for more features or on a subscription, but It’s all the same features I’m now locked out of. 

I’ve also left messages on the IG account as highlighted in the app with bugs, of which I heard nothing back. 

Poor.
author: Miles_Christi

title: Hidden costs
body: I really enjoyed this app and have been using it for a few months. I paid a one off fee to unlock the extras but this has now been reverted back to the free version and I am being asked to pay for an annual subscription. Really disappointed as there’s no evidence of previous payment and all benefits of previous payment have disappeared.
author: jomount

title: Good but a bit disappointed
body: I’ve enjoyed using this app until recently. I previously had paid for premium membership which seems to now count for nothing after the new update. Also the widget no longer functions. Despite paying again now they’ve switched to a subscription based model the widget now functions as nothing more than an annoying advert telling me I must upgrade.
author: Oliver 6

title: restore purchase faulty or very uncool tactics
body:
”choose a price, pay once & it’s forever yours”

this is what i remembered doing and thank god i took a screenshot too. took it to remember how cool developers still exist. happily paid more than the minimum.

now i’ve lost the premium features as have many others here. i hope it’s a technical problem. if not, i’ll be reporting and deleting the app too.
author: AY0099

title: Paid for lifetime but app downgraded since!
body: I’ve been using the app for a while and really loved it. I previously paid for a lifetime subscription but since the recent app update, they app seems to have downgraded me from premium and is constantly spamming me to upgrade. I have already paid so I want my premium back or money back please! I wrote to support with no response
author: Leemayson

title: Double charged! - reported to Apple for breaking T&Cs
body: I paid for this app a while back - lifetime premium. Now I’m being asked to pay again. How can this be right? Unreal and against the ethos of self improvement. This would appear to be one HUGE con. Stay away from this app at all costs
author: Buffyboy1

title: Removed all IAP features and hid them behind a subscription
body:
Paid for the IAP. All worked fine until last update, whose version notes make no mention of what they intended to do in an automated update.

They’ve removed all the premium functionality the IAP paid for and hid it behind their subscription model.

If you want to move to subscriptions fine, insist users install a new version and don’t bother updating this one. What is repugnant is taking away what has been paid for and insisting it must be paid for again.
author: queentakesbishop

title: Changed premium subs
body: A useful app however after buying premium addition they then changed to a subscription model and refused to honour or refund my original subscription. Exacerbated by a lack of response to my questions over Instagram channel. Rip-off
author: thermopyl

title: Terrible upgrade
body: Seem to be scamming everyone for premium. Luckily I never purchase one preciously but now every time I click on a habit I get a full screen premium pop up. App is being deleted.
author: Manny9019

title: Avoid - scammed loyal customers
body: I paid for the premium version three months ago and now this has been removed and everyday my alerts pop up I am greeted with a ‘pay to upgrade for premium offer of £11.99 a year’ I was under the impression of pauing for a lifetime offer that lifetime meant the rest of my life, not three months. Total scam - avoid this app at all costs
author: Yorky bloke

title: Pay
body: I must say I brought the premium one off cost a mere month ago because the app had features I wanted for now to be brought to a substitution method of payment ?
author: Simon J ward

title: SCAM
body:
I paid a one-time fee for access to the premium version of the app in early 2020. Now, with the update, my access to premium features has been removed. 

There is now a monthly subscription being advertised. Restoring the purchase from iCloud hasn't worked.
author: hmfx23

title: Misleading information
body: On here it says you can set as many goals as you want without paying anything.... this is false you can only set 3 goals then it asks you to pay.
author: courtneyswaters

title: Getting worse
body: Please stop trying to force signing up to Premium with deal countdown timers that just reset when it runs out. You can no longer add a new habit without being asked to pay for a subscription 🙁
author: bdh5678

title: Annoying upgrade message
body: I’ve used this tracker for over a year, it would have been 4 stars but since the new year they’ve put a consistent upgrade message that takes over EVERY time you open the app. Incredibly annoying, I’m deleting the app because of it.
author: H_G_G

title: They’ve basically stolen my money
body:
I paid for the premium version previously but have just discovered that my account has been reset to the basic version and I have to pay again for the additional features. The app will be uninstalled! 

Don’t waste your money (or let the developers steal it from you).
author: Rachel07

title: You have broken the App Store terms of service
body:
By removing the premium function I paid for as a lifetime purchase, you have broken the App Store terms of service as follows:

“If you are changing your existing app to a subscription-based business model, you should not take away the primary functionality existing users have already paid for. For example, let customers who have already purchased a “full game unlock” continue to access the full game after you introduce a subscription model for new customers.”

As you haven’t replied to any of mine or others emails or Instagram messages, I have reported you to Apple for breaching these terms.
author: AutomatedRandomated

title: Feeling scammed
body: I paid for lifetime premium features in July. Three days ago, without any notice, I lost my premium features overnight, and keep seeing popups asking me to pay 40£ per year. No refund available through apple, no email response from the developer, and their only other webpage (instagram profile) hasn’t been updated since 2019. How can this be allowed by apple?
author: Laury S

title: New pricing structure is a rip off
body:
As many reviewers have already said, I bought lifetime premium membership.

And now I have to pay again.

Not only that, the app advertises premium membership for a discounted price of £12/year... but then attempting to pay that, the price is £39/year
author: strawberryutopia

title: It’s good but only if you have premium
body: I used to love this app and it helps me a lot but now it has a new update or something and you can only make three habits unless u have premium, so u might as well just have premium or not have the app. Last year I had this app and I could make tons of habits and lists and now I can only make three.
author: loren_robertson

title: Lost premium access with latest update.
body:
I’ve been a user of the app for a few years, but the latest update has removed my premium purchase, and restoring it doesn’t work. 

I purchased this app because it was one of the only habit trackers not using subscription pricing. It’s a shame to see it go the way of the others.
author: chendriksen

title: Con Artists
body: Paid for lifetime access to their premium version. They’ve now switched to a subscription model and aren’t honouring the initial agreement. Scammers. Look elsewhere.
author: MichaelS1999

title: Great until...
body: Bought this app a few months ago and thought it was fab, think I paid about £5 for it and it was a nice simple app, but now they’ve brought out subscriptions for £38 a year and taken away all of the features I loved unless I pay that? That’s not fair! Feels like a con to me
author: pxrplepills

title: Limited to 3 habits unless you pay
body: Got this because you could have unlimited habits without paying - as stated above, which is a lie. You can only have 3 or you have to pay.
author: Rachie.P

title: Good app, but unable to restore my premium
body: Was really happy with the app and purchased premium to save my data on iCloud and change dark mode. After update my premium disappeared and unable to restore my purchases and not getting any support. Just asking for new payment. Disappointing
author: ivosuna

title: Scam
body: They used to charge £5 for a lifetime premium and now they charge a monthly subscription? Get out of here. I’ll track my habits in Excel or Notion for free.
author: Mattsonster

title: Paid the one time fee for premium, now asked to pay again?
body: Apple shouldn’t be allowing this.
author: djejddjebbslto

title: Premium features removed after update
body:
I purchased “lifetime” premium features, eg. Old widget support, dark mode etc. Following an update dev has switched to subscription model and instantly revoked my premium, restoring my purchase is not doing anything for me. Very disappointed and hope this can be repealed.

Also the subscription is way overpriced for this type of app, it was useful but not worth 38.99 a year
author: Basgroot

title: Paid the lifetime fee 10 days ago!
body:
A mere 10 days after I paid £4.99 to get the premium features for life, I’ve been bumped back to free because they’ve created a new pricing structure. Now whenever I go on I’m getting obnoxious ads, and features I had before aren’t available. 

This really isn’t okay! If they knew they were changing the pricing they should have disabled the £4.99 fee and premium features for new customers until it launched! 

I’ve applied to Apple for a refund on the basis I didn’t get what I paid for but no idea if I’ll get anywhere.
author: chelleynox

title: Previously paid for premium now they charge annually??
body: Like many others here I downloaded this app at the start of January and loved it so much that I paid for the lifetime premium features upgrade yet it has just been changed unannounced and wants to charge an annual fee of £40 with no mention of the fact that I have already paid. Restore purchase says it’s worked but doesn’t do anything. This is very disappointing because I loved the app. I sent them an email a few days ago but haven’t received a response so be warned!
author: Birdish168

title: Lost premium access
body:
Like everyone else, I paid £5 to upgrade to premium and two weeks later they added a yearly subscription service and I have lost my premium access.

They are not allowing purchases to be restored and judging by their Instagram they are ignoring people’s messaging. 

It’s a shame to know they have taken advantage of every loyal customer they had.
author: Rrru9

title: New premium plan very buggy
body: I got double-charged, I was subscribed before. And also still the “claim the offer” banner won’t stop appearing. Widget didn’t work and instead keep on pushing premium plan to me. Very unstable update. Please return my money. You overcharged me.
author: NotExplicable

title: Change to payment plan with no warning
body:
I was previously very happy with this app, having bought a lifetime upgrade to “premium” for extra features. The latest update has introduced a subscription model however, and I no longer have access to these features.

The update notes on the App Store page make no mention of this change, which I see as a dishonest business practice.
author: Chianti & fava beans

title: Inadequate communication and treatment of paid customers
body:
I bought the one-off premium upgrade on the 19th of Jan, expecting full access to the premium features - as promised.

One day, within two weeks of my original purchase, the app changed its payment model to subscription-only.

There was not a clear communication of this change, or what it meant.

My existing premium upgrade was not honoured. I was demoted back to the free experience, but with even more annoying ads for premium than before. (Seriously, they’re so disruptive!)

I no longer trust this developer and have deleted the app and requested a refund, since what I purchased no longer exists.
author: kieranimo

title: Used to be good - now it’s basically a scam
body:
I got this app ages ago and it was really great for ages. I paid for the premium version of the app because it was a good app. 
Now they have updated the app and stripped out the features that as a premium user I had ALREADY PAID FOR. If I want those features back I now have to pay an annual subscription fee which extortionately high. I’m obviously not going to do this and I incredibly angry I’ve lost features I already paid for. It’s basically just scamming its existing user base now. Going to look into moving to a new app, I just wish I could get back the money I’ve already paid for this app.
author: Dontkeepmehere

title: Double purchase?
body:
App is great! Easy and nice on eyes. But. You want me to pay fo it again? I paid for premium features before you guys switched to “subscription model”. So if I already paid for it, for those features, why I have to pay for it again? Just to unlock things that I already had. 

Seems a bit off for me.
author: mememmembd

title: Disappointed
body: I paid for premium a couple of weeks ago but since the new update it is now asking me to subscribe again?? Can you please rectify this as it is extremely unfair!
author: NFernandes94

title: Moved to subscription model
body:
I don’t mind a move to the subscription model but previous pro users now must pay. 

Features such as unlimited habits, which used to be free, are now premium features. 

App is now constantly urging me to upgrade to premium too with a full screen pop up, ruining the quick and simple interface. 

Cannot recommend.
author: Pravino

title: Don’t update
body:
Premium features removed from a one off purchase to a subscription model. 

Don’t download, don’t use as you can’t trust the developer.
author: davidtraxler

title: Once a good app
body: When I originally stumbled upon this app, I thought I found the holy grail for habits: simple, beautiful and with the possibility of donating to the developer. I immediately donated and made it part of my daily routine. Now the app has gone with a subscription model, effectively leaving all the previous Premium users with nothing in their hands. I can't say I'm surprised as this is a very common trend nowadays... but I was appalled by the lack of support and care towards who paid for Premium features before. Switched to "Streaks" which seems to do what I need.
author: Niccolo Granieri

title: Why has my paid version turned into the free one?
body: It looks like this app has jumped on the subscription plan bandwagon and downgraded all paid versions. I only bought it a couple months ago. Charging £20 a year to be able to choose colours and save a few lines of data in my own iCloud storage? No thank you.
author: NishitaD

title: Lost money??
body: I paid for premium a week ago when it was just a one off purchase and it was great. It now asks for a subscription which wasn’t even there before and I have no access to the features I had paid for even when I “restore my purchase”.
author: Don Blizy

title: Buyer Beware
body: Paid for premium as a one time payment previously and now they’ve changed the model to annual subscription and aren’t honouring previous purchases.

title: Subscription based?
body: So all the features I had accessed to have been revoked in order to get me to pay a monthly/yearly subscription. Surely you why this is ridiculous. I already paid for this when I first started using the app ages ago.
author: ivanc.digital

title: Scammers
body: Bought this as one time purchase for premium and now they want to make it an annual subscription. Unfettered capitalism operating at its best. Save your money and find a better substitute on the market.
author: HowsonIsNow

body:
This app is fantastic, simple but has everything you need and really motivates you to keep your new habits! 

I had bought premium when I first installed the app, but after the update yesterday I have lost all of the premium features and it is asking me to pay again? Please fix!
author: Cara Anderton

title: Subscription has cancelled my paid version?
body: The latest update has seemingly cancelled my full paid version? I’m not sure what this means that I paid for the full version, and now I’m back at square one with the latest update.
author: leonpoi2

title: Another app jumping on the subscription bandwagon
body: I paid for full access to the app via a one-off payment around a week ago, per the upgrade page in the app. Now I log in and am told that I need to pay a monthly subscription to access pro features. It isn’t acceptable to offer lifetime access one minute and to switch your pro offering to a subscription model the next, while leaving those users who paid for lifetime with no pro features. Really disappointing.
author: WesW

title: Makes you pay multiple times for the same thing
body: I really liked the app and bought the premium version as a one time purchase which was meant to give me the widget function which never worked but the other premium features worked and it was a one time purchase so I left it but now months later it’s asking me to sign up for an annual subscription to get the premium features I already paid for! Absolute scam
author: suziee2409

title: Good app, terrible customer treatment
body: I downloaded the app at the start of January, paid the ‘one-time lifetime cost’ for Premium so that I could have more colours, widget, and notifications. Three weeks later, the app has been updated and I’ve been reverted to the free version and offered a new premium annual subscription! No evidence in the app whatsoever that I’ve already paid for premium, they’ve changed their business model unannounced and expect their users to give them more money without question. It’s frustrating, because I really like the app, but this is a very disappointing experience and I’m going to look elsewhere for a similar app where the developers treat their users with more respect.
author: char_hart93

title: They a Scam artists
body: They will offer you 3 options of payment for premium, don’t be fooled. This apparently is not for premium and within a day or 2 you will find all your premium perks removed and need to pay an annual fee to unlock again.
author: Liimitz

body: This was an amazing app until the recent update. I paid for lifetime premium but the latest update has switched to a subscription model. What’s going on? Restore purchase does not restore the premium functions. Unless this is resolved my rating will remain at 1 star and I will hesitantly be moving to an alternative.

title: Premium disappeared?

body: Lost money.

title: Premium version owners scammed
body: I paid for the premium version and now the payment model has changed and I've lost access to all the premium features that I paid for. They now want me to pay £38.99 a YEAR for features I've already paid for. Restore purchases doesn't do anything. What a shame.
author: MytotheCall

title: Ruined it
body: I’ve been using this app for a while and I thought it was pretty nice, so why did you have to go and make it extremely expensive all of a sudden? £39 a year? That’s too much.
author: Vikkio92

title: Used to be great
body:
Habit used to be one of my favourite apps. One of the few I genuinely use daily to improve my life.

But the developer basically introduced a subscription and door slammed existing customers by moving them straight onto a free version with limited functionality. Besides that, the price being asked for such a simple app is outrageous.
author: Jamie Bullock

title: Avoid deceptive charging and major bugs
body:
I’ve tried this app for 4 weeks now. Nice interface but that’s where it stops 

I’ve now had to pay premium twice due to deception. One as a one time upgrade and once as part of new subscription. Is this legal or ethical?

Widget - paid for premium 2 times not never have I seen the widget - major bug and doesn’t work - poor when charging. 

I tried to delete and reinstall the app but guess what the iCloud backup doesn’t work either and wiped all the history on my tasks! Believe me it’s not that easy to re-add either. 

So far super poor and request full refund for both times I have paid ASAP please.
author: bibbster101

title: Widget not showing
body:
Purchased ‘Premium’ for £5 so I could have the Widget, but wouldn’t show on my phone. 

No response when emailed for help. :(
author: Fred McDuck

title: Needs Apple Watch support And widgets
body: Bought this app but disappointed that widgets and Apple Watch support still hasn’t been implemented
author: tadamji

title: Confusing success percentages
body: Clean, attractive interface design. Easy to set up habits and tick them off. The success percentages for each habit, whether daily or a particular number per week, make no sense though. The information about this in ‘How it works?’ is not clear either. I find the low percentage despite successfully hitting my targets demotivating so I will try a different app. (I’m using the free version.)
author: denitu

title: Great insights
body: Gives great insight into my habits without pointless gamification, nagging, or making me feel guilty. I use it most days, and happily paid for pro.
author: brewscoob

title: Meh
body: It’s so so. I paid for the premium and still no sign of widgets. I like the simple design but it still feels behind all the other habit trackers.
author: Gamr31

title: Amazing but missing features
body:
I love the simplicity and design but there’s just two things missing.

1) I like the percentage feature and I do understand it’s the apps USP but the app really should tell you how many times you’ve completed a habit. For example, let’s say I go to the gym 3 times a week, after a month I want it to tell me that I’ve been to the gym 12 times instead of just a percentage.

2) Habit stacking is a must since some habits such as reading are repeated more then once.

Past that, the app is perfect, but these features are really necessary.
author: harris_reviews

title: Love this app.
body: Amazing app, has definitely made my days more productive as ticking off tasks I’ve completed feels good. Only issue is the app keeps randomly closing when I’m ticking off tasks I’ve completed?
author: MVA XO

title: Brilliant app! Just needs something more.
body:
This app is brilliant for its purpose. It’s been really useful during lockdown to keep me from loosing my mind! I was recommended it from a training coach, and I have recommended it to others since. 
I reached 100% on a goal the other day, and nothing happened! I was expecting a visual display of some sort, like fireworks or party poppers. But instead the goal just hit 100% and is still in my list. The end reward is a bit anti-climatic.
author: Leigh-Lu

title: Great app!
body: Simple and visual

title: The best habit tracking app
body: Great app to set my goals and habits. Would love a quick widget on the latest IOS update to click widgets that I’ve completed!
author: Djm2358

title: Sweet and Simple
body:
I have been using it for more than 6 months and it has helped me develop new habits, especially during COVID-19 pandemic. 

I really love the percentage display! 90 days to turn a habit into a lifestyle. 

I would hate to lost my data so I have purchased the app for it and one thing I noticed was the widget to simply tick off the habits completed daily, I think this will help a lot.

Thank you for the amazing app! It literally changed my lifestyle for better!
author: npliceralde

title: Wonderful UX, question on widget
body: Very well designed app. I bought it how we for widget that just doesn’t want to work, restarted my phone several time and no success. Hopefully by the time you download it - it’s fixed.

author: Congjones

title: I love it
body: It just could have an overview of all the habits, to see which one you are doing the most.
author: Fox Ortega

title: More reminders
body: Good but i wish there was a way to repeat a habit more than once a day. I wanted to create one for brushing my teeth but it will only let me select to do it once a day.
author: catalan35

title: Did not restore
body:
Despite enjoying the simplicity of the app so much, the app did not restore after I uninstalled and reinstalled to try to fix random crashing

I backed up to iCloud but nothing happened when I tried to restore it

Upset, disappointed to say the least. Six months worth of habit tracking gone
author: 伦敦女孩儿

title: Best habit tracking app
body: I have tried so many different tracking apps and they have all failed me. Some very not visual enough, others really ugly, some were not simple enough. I have been using this app for over a month now and I love it so much that I had to get the premium version. Simple, stylish, informative - need I say more?
author: Elina Lukas

title: Percentage Makes No Sense
body:
I love this app but the percentage it shows for my habits makes no sense. I now haven’t ticked off one of my habits for over a month but it still shows as 100%... I don’t know if I’m not understanding what the percentages should be but I’m pretty sure if I haven’t done something for a month that it shouldn’t be saying 100%. 
Otherwise the app is great and I love how it looks. Just wish this would be fixed as it makes it way less helpful.
author: Holly Drummond

title: Great app
body:
App really allows to you track all the habits you want without being behind a paywall. I’ve got all my friends using this app and we are all working on improving! 

Keep up the great work! 💕💕
author: petey0019

title: This is 5 star but!
body: Needs a badge count to tell you how many habits are left to do & could do with a way of putting in how many times a day you need todo a habit other than that it’s 5 stars I recommend it👍🏻👍🏻
author: Igloouk

title: Dark Mode??
body: Paid for premium to use dark mode and so far I can’t see where to enable it.
author: fynctjvrjj

title: Okay app, but don’t waste your money on upgrading
body: I really liked this app, it was pretty basic but did the job so I thought I would purchase the premium version as I thought it would be better, however upon using the premium version I realised I wasted my money because I’ve paid £15 for something just as basic as the free version. I’ve tried contacting you through Instagram and email requesting a refund however I’m still awaiting a response.
author: hprime20

title: Amazing to help build habits!!
body: It’s great! Does exactly what it says! Has helped me a lot in maintaining a good morning routine and other habits such as taking vitamins/reading etc. The reminders are great! The only thing I would absolutely love is if we had the option to pick which days to get the reminders for habits we don’t repeat regularly. For example, I workout 3 times a week and would love to chose which days to get those reminders! Thank you!!
author: Smaviya

title: Love it
body: I’ve been using this app for 18months. Because of this, I’m now much more accountable to my daily achievement aspirations. Having habits to tick off daily is such a great motivation!
author: Lucy lawson

title: Perfect for achieving goals and staying accountable
body:
Love this app!

Would recommend to anyone trying to achieve their goals and create new habits
author: roxywelshgirl

title: Great App
body: I really love this app. The interface is so visually pleasing and is simple to navigate. I got it and straight away paid for the premium because I love the look of this app so much. Where I would like it to improve is possibly acknowledge the achievements for the week. An example being ‘Do College Work’ and if I set it for 4 times a week - once I’ve completed it those four times I’d like an acknowledgment of the achievement. I know it doesn’t sound like much but I can imagine it’d be more encouraging and fulfilling! Otherwise a great app that I’m sure will become greater with future updates!
author: fawn🍃

title: so happy
body: been looking for a simple app like this for ages where i can keep track of my daily to-dos. so chuffed
author: eleanormoon

body: I paid for this app and yet the widget keeps prompting me to pay. After I go to the screen to restore the purchase, it prompts me again!!!!!
author: Angeladc17

title: amazing app! ✨
body:
I don't usually write reviews but Habit is so great! It has motivated me to exercise, read, drink water and so much more. The app is beautifully minimalistic and easy to manage. It does have a premium option but it is completely optional and it doesn't feel like the developers are shoving it down your throat! title: An Outstanding App... but nothing’s perfect
body:
This app is incredible, to such an extent that I even made an in-app purchase, something which I very rarely do, after just 1 day of use as I knew this was exactly the UX that I envisaged. However, nothing’s perfect and I would like to see:

1. Better Organisation - though I can just about make do with colours as of now, perhaps adding “groups” of sorts would be better, and then assign each group its own colour. For instance, I have organised all of my “Sports” activities into the green colour and all of my “chores” activities into the blue, etc.

2. More Controls - The daily reminder feature that you have set as of now is only a first step into what I would like. As a pro user, if you could somehow intergrate multiple “ticks” per day, for instance, I might need to take an antibiotic four times a day (and be able to set the time for each respective reminder), that would be absolutely incredible. Conversely, on the other side of the spectrum, for some events that I need to do every several days or several months, setting a reminder at intervals for several months or years would be similarly great!

Keep up the good work! And by the way, a final lowest-priority suggestion would be if you could manage to make your app cross-platform through a web app, such as the way Todoist operates, so I can tick things, but honestly, I can usually just whip out my phone to do so.

title: A worthy competitor to the big apps
body:
When it comes to finding apps, I tend to be a bit biased towards the ones that offer the most functionality for free and/or without subscriptions - I like to be able to see the breadth of functionality an app offers before I make a decision to part with my hard earned cash.

Unlike the many other habit tracking apps, this app prioritises on delivering that functionality over skimping on useful features hidden behind paywalls. 
It’s honestly a breath of fresh air to find an app that seems to prioritise what the user wants, rather than trying to find a clear source of revenue. 
With that in mind, it’s worth mentioning that the app has an optional ‘pay-what-you-want’; I’m very satisfied with what the app offers at its current stage, so I won’t hesitate to throw some money in the developers direction! 😊

title: Chart and percentages fixed and limited and not aligned with users’s goals
body:
The chart and the percentages do not reflect the acomplishment of your tasks.

I think monthly percentage should be calculated based on your personal goals if not that gives one the feeling of truly never achieving your personal goal.
 
For example there are task that you don’t perform every day so you will never achieve 100% because it is fixed to a 90 day streak. 

for example for those tasks that I can’t perform every day it would be impossible to reach 100%. 

I mean, we all have schedules and in real life we have work, school and multiple tasks, family, etc... that makes it difficult to do a task every day and that’s why we schedule tasks to perform in specific periods of time and the percentages should be calculated based on your personal goals. 

So for example if you set your personal goal (Study German) to 2 times a week then your 100% accomplishment would be 8 times in a month because that is what you set as your personal goal on the other hand if it is calculated on 90 days streak you will never achieve your personal goals and the percentage will never be align with your personal goal.

The app is also lacking the ability to specify the days you want to perform the task for example:

Workout 
Monday, Friday and Saturday.

Read 
Saturday and Sunday

title: Great app, and free!
body:
Simple and effective habit tracker, love the simple 1 tap input, and the colorful bubbles that grow as your habits get stronger. A really great job for a first version 👍

One of the few apps on this market that’s still free and doesn’t offer a paid subscription to access full functionality or remove ads 🙌

A couple of caveats:

- The main screen gets fairly cluttered when you have many habits to track, you end up having to scroll up and down a lot. Maybe a compact list view as an option could help, or the possibility to group habits by theme (e.g. health, relationships, work).

- It isn’t clear whether or not weekly habits (or any non daily repetition) get tracked properly in terms of percentage. I haven’t gone through a full month yet, so I can’t confirm. But at the very least the interface doesn’t make that clear at all.

- Negative habits (e.g. no coffee, less alcohol) are a bit awkward to track. A dedicated feature would probably help. You may want to look at what other habit trackers are doing on that front 😉

All that being said, it’s pretty great app overall, I’ll definitely keep tracking my habits and growing them this way. Thanks for that 🙏
